fact: The Interior Ministry's deputy secretary general says implementation of the National Population Register (RNP) is under way, with a first enrolment phase to begin in Niamey's five communal districts before extension to other regions in 2027.

The Interior Ministry's deputy secretary general announced the forthcoming National Population Register (RNP), a central secure database giving each citizen a unique identifier, with ANEI created by decree 2026-242.
The Interior Ministry says the National Population Register (RNP) will start in Niamey in the coming weeks, with national extension from 2027 under the future ANEI.

The Interior Ministry's deputy secretary general says a National Population Register (RNP) will be set up, with a first phase of enrolment in Niamey's five communal districts in the coming weeks and extension to other regions in early 2027.

Le Sahel reports that the WURI project is developing a National Population Register (RNP) under the new agency ANEI, created by decree of 22 April 2026, with enrolment starting in the five arrondissements of Niamey in the coming weeks.

Niger's director general of territorial administration said on 2026-09-03 that the reforms include creating a National Population Register, to become a single interoperable referential, with a unique number for each person.

Niger's Registre National de la Population is being constituted, centred on biometric enrolment of the population, with deconcentrated actors to carry out the registration operations, officials said at the Agadez workshop (ANP).
